import numpy as np

def comps(grid, col):
    g=np.array(grid); seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(10):
        for c in range(10):
            if g[r,c]==col and (r,c) not in seen:
                stack=[(r,c)]; cells=[]
                seen.add((r,c))
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<10 and 0<=y<10 and g[x,y]==col and (x,y) not in seen:
                            seen.add((x,y)); stack.append((x,y))
                rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
                r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs)
                rel=sorted(((a-r0,b-c0) for a,b in cells))
                out.append({'cells':cells,'r0':r0,'c0':c0,'h':max(rs)-r0+1,'w':max(cs)-c0+1,'n':len(cells),'rel':rel})
    return out
